request.purpose: Research piracy, corsairing and maritime activity connected to the island of Milos in the Aegean between 1660 and 1680 inclusive. Start with primary and contemporary sources, travellers and archival catalogues. Find attacks, captures, captivity, ransom, anchorage or operational-base use where supported. Distinguish mere presence and ordinary maritime activity from piracy; do not assume an event, pirate identity or base status. Preserve source identity, original date wording, exact locators, source context, access blockers and uncertainty. This is a fresh end-to-end evaluation of the current research engine; do not reuse earlier conclusions as evidence or inject known benchmark sources.

verification.rule: Verification is evidence-weighted and claim-specific; no automated stage may set HUMAN_REVIEWED or VERIFIED.

normalized_request.purpose: Research piracy, corsairing and maritime activity connected to the island of Milos in the Aegean between 1660 and 1680 inclusive. Start with primary and contemporary sources, travellers and archival catalogues. Find attacks, captures, captivity, ransom, anchorage or operational-base use where supported. Distinguish mere presence and ordinary maritime activity from piracy; do not assume an event, pirate identity or base status. Preserve source identity, original date wording, exact locators, source context, access blockers and uncertainty. This is a fresh end-to-end evaluation of the current research engine; do not reuse earlier conclusions as evidence or inject known benchmark sources.

execution_manifest.note: GitHub Actions retains platform logs separately; durable research evidence and file SHA-256 values are preserved under evidence/runs.

limitations: Catalogue metadata does not prove an event.
OCR/event proximity is a discovery lead only.
Blocked repositories remain explicit research gaps.
No candidate is VERIFIED without original inspection, extraction, genealogy assessment and human review.
